limits: Baseline strategy is pinned while shared current library, geometry and placeables are used on both sides. Three current-library authored maps, ten direct 24x18 cases, twelve varied-shape cases, a >32-portal case and eight dumbbell variants with 10x20 lobes, 2/3-cell necks and one or two portals on the left lobe. Checks exact primary geometry and full crate access rings, fill constraints, portal reach, and independent integer-intersection hunter reach with swept-clearance cardinal edges. A previously reachable node fails only if it remains walkable but becomes disconnected; newly blocked nodes are reported separately. Up to 20 spatially spread retained baseline loot sites use contestant-sized findRegionRoute checks from a shared baseline anchor and fail only on new losses. This bounded sample is not a proof of continuous-space reachability; removed sampled loot and pre-existing errors and map defects are reported separately. No claim of human balance, exhaustive coverage or performance beyond these samples.
postRunAnnotation: Audit imported REGION_TYPES_VERSION types-45 before the metadata bump to types-46; the same candidate ruins placement implementation ran throughout. Commit and source hashes were collected at report completion after the bump. Final production strategy identity is types-46. Documentation comment was expanded during the run without changing placement logic.
